checks.detail: Expected mobile on eth1. Restore the baseline before starting.

name: mac-move
title: MAC move between MLAG peers and back
action: Switches the MAC-move host's active-backup bond from its link to CHR 1 to its link to CHR 2, keeping the same MAC and IP address, then switches it back after 4 s.

forwarding.status: not available: evaluation stopped before the streams were scored

phases.name: Move to CHR 2
phases.expected: The host's gratuitous ARP enters CHR 2 on ether5, a regular bridge port without mlag-id. CHR 2 moves the host MAC to ether5 in its bridge host table and floods the broadcast to its local ports and over the peer port; CHR 1 floods it only to its regular port ether5 and moves the MAC to the peer port ether2. Lab target: no probe to or from the host is lost, and once the gratuitous ARP reaches CHR 2, no frame addressed to the host MAC leaves CHR 1 on ether5.

phases.name: Move back to CHR 1
phases.expected: The host's gratuitous ARP enters CHR 1 on ether5. CHR 1 moves the host MAC back to ether5 and floods the broadcast to its local ports and over the peer port; CHR 2 floods it only to its regular port ether5 and moves the MAC to the peer port ether2. Lab target: no probe to or from the host is lost, and from the moment the gratuitous ARP reaches CHR 1 to the end of the recovery window, no frame addressed to the host MAC leaves CHR 2 on ether5.
